rationale: AST also explains attention control and the modeling of others, which a theory of belief alone would not.

sources.locator: A Theory of Consciousness that Embodies Principles 1 and 2
sources.quote: A common misunderstanding about AST is that it merely explains how people have a general, cognitive belief in a nonphysical mind
Yes, AST explains why we believe we have consciousness, but to insist only on that facet of AST misses the bigger picture.
